name: True Necromancy
description: (Tag:summon)Enact true necromancy sanctioned by Death itself to raise corpses into undead such as Gravelords, Night Liches, Vampire Lords, Nightmare Kings, Undead Dragons, Corpse Titans, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Epic Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 2500 at once.
